race.comment: ROYAL GHOST (2) finds it hard to break through. Better run when finding the frame last time though, finishing third (20.13) at this track. Top prospect. HARA'S CRUMPET (8) comes off an average effort last start when fifth at this track over 366m behind Frog's Rock (20.24) in a Grade 6. Good beginner but will need a little luck early crossing from an outside draw. Has ability and can atone. JUNGLE GIRL (1) was safely held in tougher company last start after being shuffled back early at this track, but prior to that won by a neck at this track (20.34) beating Stinger Bee in a Maiden on November 8. Reliable out of the boxes and should take advantage of the inside draw. Better than last start and can bounce back. JAKARI BUDGIE (7) gets a chance to redeem an unplaced effort here last start.
